base: original CMAB LinTS, three input features, original P1203-derived immediate proxy reward

reference.purpose: Adapter check; the main baseline is still the actual abrCMAB path

memory.hypothesis: H1: isolate data retention while preserving the forced-choice schedule

startup.startup_action: highest nominal representation below safe measured throughput
startup.hypothesis: H2: restart treatment changes both forced duration and initial quality; report this as a package

delayed.feedback: Original P1203 proxy evaluated when the associated request completes, using captured action/context and outcome-time latency/stall history
delayed.training_rows: unique linked completed requests; exact request-object association
delayed.censored: unmatched, error, abandoned or seek-cancelled requests
delayed.qualification: Timing/attribution package changes the observation/update clock; not timing in isolation

outcome.qualification: Download utility and buffer-budget starvation surrogate. Neither actual played QoE nor exact causal stall attribution. Completed segment may later be skipped.

unchanged_factors: For the first factorial: three features, LinTS alpha/default seed, reward/timing and system controls. Delayed/outcome changes are separately declared.
